title: RoboCup 2023 Humanoid AdultSize Winner NimbRo: NimbRoNet3 Visual Perception and Responsive Gait with Waveform In-Walk Kicks
venueFull: RoboCup 2023: Robot World Cup XXVI (Springer LNCS)
summary: Describes the upgrades behind team NimbRo's win in the RoboCup 2023 Humanoid AdultSize soccer tournament: the NimbRoNet3 visual perception model, extended fused-angle feedback with an added COM-ZMP controller for robust walking, and parametric waveform-based in-walk kicks.
